name: When should I call a plumber for a gurgling drain?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a plumber for a gurgling drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a plumber if your gurgling drain persists after attempting simple DIY fixes like plunging or using boiling water. It's also advisable to call a professional if multiple drains in your home are gurgling simultaneously, as this often points to a more significant issue with your main sewer line or vent stack. Strong sewer odors accompanying the gurgling or signs of slow drainage in other fixtures are also indicators that a professional inspection is needed. Early intervention can prevent more extensive damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber if gurgling persists, if multiple drains gurgle, or if there are accompanying odors or widespread slow drainage.
